name: Persona drift detection
definition: Evaluates whether generated student messages maintain persona fidelity across a full conversation.
judge_context_inputs: interleaved conversation context with generated student turns labeled for scoring

score_scales.5: No drift; persona perfectly maintained throughout.
score_scales.4: Minimal drift; slight changes in later turns.
score_scales.3: Moderate drift; noticeable persona weakening after midpoint.
score_scales.2: Significant drift; persona breaks down in later half.

aggregation_formula: mean(live overall_drift_score), mean per-turn persona_fidelity, drift_onset distribution, and failure taxonomy counts by model/persona/task
